content.short: jpegd is the JPEG'd protocol that enables users to collateralize NFTs for a synthetic stablecoin.
content.description: The JPEG'd protocol provides a primitive, non-fungible debt position (NFDP) that behaves similarly to other NFT lending protocols. Specific NFT collections are supported based on liquidity and market capitalization. Users deposit their NFT into a smart contract to mint a synthetic stablecoin, $PUSD. This stablecoin can be used for other opportunities while their NFT remains on the platform. Debt positions can be taken up to 32% of the collateral value.
